signatures.head: def Locale := Frmᵒᵖ deriving LargeCategory
instance : CoeSort Locale Type* := ⟨fun X => X.unop⟩
instance (X : Locale) : Frame X := X.unop.str
structure Order.Frame.MinimalAxioms (α : Type u) [CompleteLattice α] where
class Order.Frame (α : Type*) extends CompleteLattice α, HeytingAlgebra α where
theorem inf_sSup_eq [Frame α] {s : Set α} {a : α} : a ⊓ sSup s = ⨆ b ∈ s, a ⊓ b := gc_inf_himp.l_sSup
abbrev PT := FrameHom L Prop
def openOfElementHom : FrameHom L (Set (PT L)) where
def pt : Locale ⥤ TopCat where

def IsUniversalColimit {F : J ⥤ C} (c : Cocone F) : Prop := ∀ ⦃F' : J ⥤ C⦄ (c' : Cocone F') (α : F' ⟶ F) (f : c'.pt ⟶ c.pt) (_ : α ≫ c.ι = c'.ι ≫ (Functor.const J).map f) (_ : NatTrans.Equifibered α), (∀ j : J, IsPullback (c'.ι.app j) (α.app j) f (c.ι.app j)) → Nonempty (IsColimit c')
noncomputable def IsUniversalColimit.isColimit {F : J ⥤ C} {c : Cocone F} (h : IsUniversalColimit c) : IsColimit c
theorem IsUniversalColimit.of_iso {F : J ⥤ C} {c c' : Cocone F} (hc : IsUniversalColimit c) (e : c ≅ c') : IsUniversalColimit c'
class WellPowered [LocallySmall.{w} C] : Prop where
instance small_subobject [LocallySmall.{w} C] [WellPowered C] (X : C) : Small.{w} (Subobject X) := WellPowered.subobject_small X
instance [LocallySmall.{w} C] [WellPowered.{w} C] : WellPowered.{w, w} (ShrinkHoms C) := wellPowered_of_equiv.{w} (ShrinkHoms.equivalence.{w} C)
